gf-n-seasons.label: KKR seasons in the warehouse
gf-n-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
gf-n-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (6) OR m.team2_id IN (6)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

gf-titles.label: KKR titles, as winner of the season's final
gf-titles.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
gf-titles.filters: Final = last match of each season
gf-titles.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id) AND (m.team1_id IN (6) OR m.team2_id IN (6))

gf-age.label: Years since Kolkata Knight Riders' first season
gf-age.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
gf-age.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(DISTINCT pid) players FROM ( SELECT m.season_id, m.match_id, d.batter_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (6) UNION SELECT m.season_id, m.match_id, d.bowler_id FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (6)) m GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
